assets.name: 血迹废旧桌面
assets.prompt: Use case illustration-story. One final wide 16:9 Japanese cel-animation game tabletop background, perfectly top down. A worn old school wooden investigation desk inside a dark sealed abandoned school after apocalypse. Very dark scratched gray-brown planks, chipped varnish, black moisture rot and cracked edges. Dried dark red blood smears, streaks and partial bloody fingerprints along upper left and lower right edges, a small trail of crimson droplets toward corners, slightly blood-soaked gauze at extreme upper right beside battered shut metal medical tin. Upper left a corner of torn blank evidence paper with a crimson thumbprint. Center 75 percent mostly empty matte low-contrast worn dark wood so overlay cards remain clear; no big high-contrast spots in center. Oppressive horror, cold desaturated blue-gray lighting and one very subtle dim red emergency side light. Hand ink contours, hard-edged color planes, cel anime background, no photographic texture, no glossy 3D. No bodies, limbs, organs, people, writing, text, UI, card art, symbols, magic, ornament, flowers. No pool of fresh blood across whole playing area. Dried blood feels real and ominous, never decorative pattern. Dark enough to feel abandoned, enough muted highlights to read wood grain.
